title: Providers — Publishing and Discovery
description: Which providers publish their catalogues to the network, and how often their data is returned in discover results.

query.rawSql:
SELECT DISTINCT transform(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider
FROM otel.otel_logs
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(LogAttributes['message'], 'catalogs') AS c
WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
  AND provider != ''
ORDER BY provider

list.name: stale_after
list.label: Stale after
list.description: A provider is stale when it has not published a catalogue for longer than this.

options.content: A **catalogue** is the list of data a provider offers. **Publishing** sends it to the network so it can be found by **discover**. A provider appears here once it publishes or is returned in a discover result; registrations are not shown yet.

panels.title: Published providers
panels.description: Providers with at least one catalogue published.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExactIf(provider, accepted) AS providers FROM (
SELECT
  request, ts, failed_request,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id') AS provider_id,
  transform(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'id') AS catalog,
  arrayFirst(r -> JSONExtractString(r, 'catalogId') = JSONExtractString(cat, 'id'),
             JSONExtractArrayRaw(resp, 'results')) AS result,
  JSONExtractUInt(result, 'stats', 'itemCount') AS items,
  NOT failed_request AND JSONExtractString(result, 'status') = 'ACCEPTED' AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'request') AS req,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response') AS resp,
    max(toUInt16OrZero(LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'])) >= 400 AS failed_request
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'publish')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(req, 'catalogs') AS cat
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)

panels.title: Providers in discover results
panels.description: Providers whose data was returned in at least one discover result.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT uniqExact(provider) AS providers FROM (
SELECT request, ts, provider
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(
      arrayMap(c -> transform(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'))), JSONExtractArrayRaw(LogAttributes['message'], 'catalogs'))
    ))) AS providers
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response'
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'discover')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN providers AS provider
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)

panels.title: Stale providers
panels.description: Providers with no catalogue published within the Stale after period.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT countIf(last_ok < now() - toIntervalSecond(${stale_after:raw})) AS stale
FROM (SELECT provider, maxIf(ts, accepted) AS last_ok FROM (
SELECT
  request, ts, failed_request,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id') AS provider_id,
  transform(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'id') AS catalog,
  arrayFirst(r -> JSONExtractString(r, 'catalogId') = JSONExtractString(cat, 'id'),
             JSONExtractArrayRaw(resp, 'results')) AS result,
  JSONExtractUInt(result, 'stats', 'itemCount') AS items,
  NOT failed_request AND JSONExtractString(result, 'status') = 'ACCEPTED' AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'request') AS req,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response') AS resp,
    max(toUInt16OrZero(LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'])) >= 400 AS failed_request
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'publish')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(req, 'catalogs') AS cat
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
) GROUP BY provider HAVING countIf(accepted) > 0)

SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, countIf(accepted) AS "Catalogues published" FROM (
SELECT
  request, ts, failed_request,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id') AS provider_id,
  transform(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'id') AS catalog,
  arrayFirst(r -> JSONExtractString(r, 'catalogId') = JSONExtractString(cat, 'id'),
             JSONExtractArrayRaw(resp, 'results')) AS result,
  JSONExtractUInt(result, 'stats', 'itemCount') AS items,
  NOT failed_request AND JSONExtractString(result, 'status') = 'ACCEPTED' AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'request') AS req,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response') AS resp,
    max(toUInt16OrZero(LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'])) >= 400 AS failed_request
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'publish')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(req, 'catalogs') AS cat
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
) GROUP BY time ORDER BY time WITH FILL FROM toStartOfInterval($__fromTime, INTERVAL $__interval_s second) TO $__toTime STEP $__interval_s

panels.title: Provider status
panels.description: Status of each provider. Active: last catalogue published within the Stale after period. Stale: nothing published within that period. Last publish failed: the latest catalogue was rejected. Publishing failed: every catalogue was rejected. Not published: seen only in discover results. Items in last publish: items in the last accepted catalogue.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  provider AS "Provider",
  multiIf(countIf(kind = 'publish') = 0, 'Not published',
          countIf(kind = 'publish' AND accepted) = 0, 'Publishing failed',
          NOT argMaxIf(accepted, ts, kind = 'publish'), 'Last publish failed',
          maxIf(ts, kind = 'publish' AND accepted) < now() - toIntervalSecond(${stale_after:raw}), 'Stale',
          'Active') AS "Status",
  if(countIf(kind = 'publish' AND accepted) > 0, maxIf(ts, kind = 'publish' AND accepted), NULL) AS "Last published",
  countIf(kind = 'publish' AND accepted) AS "Catalogues published",
  countIf(kind = 'publish' AND NOT accepted) AS "Catalogues rejected",
  arraySum(arrayMap(t -> t.3,
    arrayFilter(t -> t.1 = argMaxIf(request, ts, kind = 'publish' AND accepted),
                groupArrayIf((request, ts, items), kind = 'publish' AND accepted)))) AS "Items in last publish",
  uniqExactIf(request, kind = 'answer') AS "In discover results"
FROM (
  SELECT 'publish' AS kind, request, ts, provider, provider_id, items, accepted FROM (
SELECT
  request, ts, failed_request,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id') AS provider_id,
  transform(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'id') AS catalog,
  arrayFirst(r -> JSONExtractString(r, 'catalogId') = JSONExtractString(cat, 'id'),
             JSONExtractArrayRaw(resp, 'results')) AS result,
  JSONExtractUInt(result, 'stats', 'itemCount') AS items,
  NOT failed_request AND JSONExtractString(result, 'status') = 'ACCEPTED' AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'request') AS req,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response') AS resp,
    max(toUInt16OrZero(LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'])) >= 400 AS failed_request
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'publish')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(req, 'catalogs') AS cat
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)
  UNION ALL
  SELECT 'answer' AS kind, request, ts, provider, '' AS provider_id, 0 AS items, false AS accepted FROM (
SELECT request, ts, provider
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(
      arrayMap(c -> transform(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'))), JSONExtractArrayRaw(LogAttributes['message'], 'catalogs'))
    ))) AS providers
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response'
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'discover')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN providers AS provider
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)
)
GROUP BY provider
ORDER BY provider

panels.title: Catalogues published
panels.description: When a provider's bars stop, it has stopped publishing.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, provider, count() AS catalogues
FROM (
SELECT
  request, ts, failed_request,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id') AS provider_id,
  transform(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(cat, 'provider', 'id'))) AS provider,
  JSONExtractString(cat, 'id') AS catalog,
  arrayFirst(r -> JSONExtractString(r, 'catalogId') = JSONExtractString(cat, 'id'),
             JSONExtractArrayRaw(resp, 'results')) AS result,
  JSONExtractUInt(result, 'stats', 'itemCount') AS items,
  NOT failed_request AND JSONExtractString(result, 'status') = 'ACCEPTED' AS accepted
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'request') AS req,
    anyIf(LogAttributes['message'], LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response') AS resp,
    max(toUInt16OrZero(LogAttributes['http.response.status_code'])) >= 400 AS failed_request
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] IN ('request', 'response')
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'publish')
  GROUP BY request

ARRAY JOIN JSONExtractArrayRaw(req, 'catalogs') AS cat
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)
WHERE accepted
GROUP BY time, provider
ORDER BY time

panels.title: In discover results
panels.description: How many discover results included each provider's data.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT $__timeInterval(ts) AS time, provider, count() AS answers
FROM (
SELECT request, ts, provider
FROM (
  SELECT
    LogAttributes['message_id'] AS request,
    min(Timestamp) AS ts,
    arrayDistinct(arrayFlatten(groupArray(
      arrayMap(c -> transform(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'), ['bharat-vistaar', 'pocra'], ['Knowledge', 'PoCRA'], if(JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name') != '', JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'descriptor', 'name'), JSONExtractString(c, 'provider', 'id'))), JSONExtractArrayRaw(LogAttributes['message'], 'catalogs'))
    ))) AS providers
  FROM otel.otel_logs
  WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp)
    AND LogAttributes['audit.direction'] = 'response'
    AND LogAttributes['message_id'] IN (
    SELECT SpanAttributes['message_id']
    FROM otel.otel_traces
    WHERE $__timeFilter(Timestamp) AND SpanKind = 'Server' AND replaceRegexpOne(SpanName, '^/', '') = 'discover')
  GROUP BY request
)
ARRAY JOIN providers AS provider
WHERE provider != '' AND $__conditionalAll(provider IN ($provider), $provider)
)
GROUP BY time, provider
ORDER BY time
